title: Italian Vegetable Essence Soup
description: A hearty and comforting Italian-style soup made with a variety of vegetables and a hint of essence.
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped carrots, celery, and onion to the pot and sauté until tender.
Add the essence and canned diced tomatoes to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
